published_source: Printed Table 3, column (5) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2022.01333.pdf), read Nov 4 2026
replication_status: exact (authors' Stata did_imputation, Code/Table3.do line 60, cannot run here: the did_imputation ado is not installed and there is no network; the same BJS imputation estimator run in R didimputation 0.5.1 on the shipped finJRSP_estimationdata_torun_NEWVER.dta with unit user, time weekdate, cohort event_week, cluster cohort: 0.104706 (0.005943), N 323,850; printed Table 3, column (5): 0.105 (0.00594), N 323,850)
notes: did_imputation isBestAnswer user weekdate event_week, cluster(cohort) [Code/Table3.do line 60]. Published value from Outputs/CorrectBestAnswer.tex col (5). Same design/data as T3_isBestAnswer_twfe_basic: run_spec.R output is identical to that spec; published_coef here is the authors' BJS estimate, not a TWFE. Deduplicate against the twfe spec in any TWFE-vs-modern comparison. Answer-level repeated cross-section assigned to users (323,850 answers, 5,339 users, 472 consecutive weeks 2008w30-2017w33; mean 3.7 answers per user-week). Unit = user, time = weekdate, cohort date = event_week (Russian 2010w41 = 2640, Portuguese 2013w50 = 2805, Japanese 2014w39 = 2846, Spanish 2015w44 = 2903); control group (TreatmentGroup == 'Control', 37,049 answers) has event_week missing = never treated. No always-treated users; every treated user has pre- and post-period answers; treatment is absorbing. The authors' TWFE regressor `after` is based on event_day and equals (weekdate >= event_week) except in 162 answers posted earlier in the adoption week; run_spec.R uses gvar = event_week (the cohort variable the authors pass to did_imputation). Authors cluster on cohort (5 clusters), kept here as cluster_var; the protocol leverage screen will fail with 5 clusters (recorded deviation: user-clustered sensitivity in the log). Published Table 3 is the authors' manual merge of Outputs/Correct.tex and Outputs/CorrectBestAnswer.tex; column numbers refer to those files. Article text not in the project.
